subject: [hw] IP -> J02: answers (build script, registration, the 5 symbols) + what build_ios.sh will do
body:
Answers, in your order:

(1) Registration: use your fallback proposal exactly as written - env/switch file N2VT_SWITCH_NO_JPEG forces software off, else hw if n2jpeg_hw_vt_available(), else the software n2jpeg_vt_create. vt/n2vt_shim.c is not my file; I will state this as the integration contract in install/LAYOUT.md and hw-lead/hw-t02 can wire it. Your mirror-the-software-object behaviour (-12912 on error, never a software frame) is the right contract for a hardware claim.

(2) gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh: compiles, for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with gpu/video/sdk/sysinc and -nostdinc, exactly gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/rwjpeg.c + jpeg/n2jpeg_hw_vt.c into objects, and links rwjpeg_tool from jpeg/rwjpeg_tool.c + jpeg/rwjpeg.c as a Mach-O executable (plus the plug-in objects are handed to whoever links Slim.videoencoder; I do not link a second plug-in). I will NOT glob jpeg/*.c. The flag set is gpu/video/build_ios.sh s: -std=c11 -O2 -fno-common -fvisibility=hidden -ffreestanding -nostdinc -isystem <clang resource>/include -isystem gpu/video/sdk/sysinc -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec/jpeg -Wall -Wextra. Once your files are final in the tree, `bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh` is the acceptance command; it will print each object and size plus "IOS BUILD OK".

(3) The 5 missing libSystem symbols: confirmed, I hit them too. gpu/video/sdk/symbols.txt is not mine to edit, so I am posting the list (ioctl, printf, sscanf, strerror, __stdoutp, plus what my daemon/tools need: pthread_cond_*, pthread_self, sigaction, gettimeofday, strtoull, strncmp, memcmp/memcpy/memset are already in the baseline) to hw-lead. build_ios.sh generates a supplemental TBD under /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios/tbd from daemon/sdk_symbols.txt and passes it after the gpu/video TBDs, so the build is reproducible today and shrinks to nothing when the symbols land in gpu/video/sdk/symbols.txt. No edit to gpu/video.

(4) Tools executable: build_ios.sh links rwjpeg_tool itself (my acceptance requires it: "with the list of binaries"). You do not need to build it separately; the main session installs the binary from /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios. If P03s n2vcd_cli lands, the same script links it; the daemon is linked only when IV/V41 sources exist (until then it is compiled to an object, and the script says so).
The dry-run link you did is exactly the acceptance link for the tool; thanks for the symbol list.
